profile.headline: Senior Engineering Manager at Capital One
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Experienced Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the consumer electronics industry. Skilled in Management, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Adobe Photoshop. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused in Biophysics from Temple University.

positions.title: Digital Project Manager
positions.description:
Collaborate with the development and creative team to provide the best solutions for user interfaces for the web.
Manage a team of 6-8 engineers for small to larger scale projects.
Manage day-to-day communication between engineers, designers, vendors, and clients to ensure that project goals and time requirements are met.
Allocate assignments to engineers by setting milestones, as well as tracking technical issue within site frames.
Create and deliver technical and non-technical documentation for custom CMSs.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Apply extensive knowledge of HTML, XML, CSS and jQuery to implement responsive web and mobile sites.
Test, and document webpages for cross-browser, cross-platform compatibility.
Collaborate with designers and developers to produce designed-focused technology solutions.
Used Photoshop and Illustrator to create and optimize web-ready graphics.
Create and modify custom CMSs.

positions.title: Research Associate
positions.description:
Worked closely with graduate students in the area of Atomic Material Physics.
Attended to tedious care for rare earth base material for the use of laser refrigerators. 
Designed and implemented methods to better ensure the use of the rare earth base material.
Prepped materials for experimental procedures such as aligning laser, detecting helium leaks in high vacuum systems, and created clean environments for vacuum boxes.
Kept laboratory inventory and order new stocks, if necessary.
Test electronic equipment using an oscilloscope or power meter.
